title: Model Performance Record
description: Schema for recording model performance metrics with full traceability to source data and code execution context.

model_name.description: Name of the model being evaluated (e.g., 'RandomForest', 'GradientBoosting').

metric_value.description: The calculated value of the metric.

data_row_id.description: UUID of the specific row in the source data file (e.g., data/derived/filtered_alloys.csv) used for this evaluation point. Ensures traceability to exact input data.

code_block_id.description: Identifier of the specific code block, function, or script version that generated this record. Used for reproducibility and audit trails (Constitution IV).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the metric was calculated.

fold_index.description: Index of the cross-validation fold (if applicable).

validation_limitation_note.description: Optional notes regarding limitations or specific conditions of this evaluation.
